content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user who manages tasks","i_want":"to sort the tasks in the report by Creation Date, Due Date, Status, Priority or Title","so_that":"I can see my tasks in the order that matters to me","business_description":"The Task Reporting page lets the user sort its task table by Creation Date, Due Date, Status, Priority or Title. The report API accepts the sort field and returns the matching tasks in that order.","business_value":"Sorting the report by the fields the PRD names lets the user find the most urgent or relevant tasks quickly.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays at least two tasks with different Creation Dates","when":"The user selects the sort option Creation Date","then":"The table rows are reordered so that the Creation Date values are in one consistent order (ascending or descending, as defined by the sort control) and the sort option shown as selected is Creation Date"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays tasks with different Due Dates","when":"The user selects the sort option Due Date","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Due Date field and the sort option shown as selected is Due Date"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays tasks with different Status values","when":"The user selects the sort option Status","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Status field and the sort option shown as selected is Status"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays tasks with different Priority values","when":"The user selects the sort option Priority","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Priority field and the sort option shown as selected is Priority"},{"given":"The Task Reporting page displays at least two tasks with different titles","when":"The user selects the sort option Title","then":"The table rows are reordered by the Title field in one consistent order and the sort option shown as selected is Title"},{"given":"The report API is called with a sort field of creation_date, due_date, status, priority or title","when":"The request is processed by the backend","then":"The response contains the matching tasks ordered by that field"},{"given":"The report API is called with a sort field that is not one of creation_date, due_date, status, priority or title","when":"The request is processed by the backend","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error and no task data is returned"}],"edge_cases":["The PRD does not state the sort direction (ascending or descending) or whether it can be question.","The PRD does not define how Title is compared (case sensitivity, locale); this is an open question.","The PRD does not define the order of tasks that have equal values for the sort field; this is an open question.","The PRD does not state how tasks with an empty Due Date or Completion Date are placed when sorting; this is an open question.","A sort field value sent in a different
